ProjectionNotes: Each Sequence is the one-based observation index within the cited native run. Original native labels remain intact; bucket/account/version/upload identities are rebound.

Local setup creates the captured role permissions and real STS sessions with native session policies. Owner Delegated user normalizes to owned root. Existing foreign OrganizationAccountAccessRole broad S3 identity authority is reconstructed locally; the native role was not mutated and its complete policy was not captured.
AWSHTTP calls only. Earlier CLI Body/GET preflight and post-cleanup NoSuchBucket repair are distinct non-authority evidence; no local preflight error is replayed as an AWS status.

Native time becomes manual service time at millisecond precision. Fixed explicit object headers keep captured wire seconds; retention XML body dates retain native milliseconds. Latency is removed. Default deadlines derive from local write/initiation; active event-hold horizons derive from the read instant.

Automatic checksums, provider request IDs, transport dates and error prose are excluded. GET bytes, optional retention/legal header presence, lock XML, SDK metadata, native codes/statuses and generated default deadlines remain consumer assertions.

Retained reopen boundaries preserve IAM roles, sessions, bucket policies, object lock metadata and pending multipart uploads. Same session and opaque resource identities are reused after reconstruction.
Run[2] audit-only traffic is omitted; remove-default-for-unlocked remains the prerequisite for unprotected event-condition targets. Positive audit delivery replay is owned separately.

Variable GET uses raw wire XML because the SDK does not model EventHold/EventHoldDuration. Raw native condition mutation requests retain checksums and object-lock headers; signed transport fields regenerate locally.
Limitations: Earlier Body and GET CLI preflight failures are retained distinctly from actual AWS HTTP evidence; subsequent successful native captures complete the requested coverage.
GOVERNANCE only in owned authority resources; no compliance default, fixed compliance, or variable compliance was created.

Event-hold/default-duration IAM observations conflict with request-only wording in current Object Lock management guide: native effective defaults supply these keys to PutObject admission, while implicit defaults do not authorize PutObjectRetention.

CompleteMultipartUpload with explicit retention initiated under broader permissions then completed without retention/legal grants was not captured; initiation grant checks and same-actor completion observations are retained.
